title: Murmur synthesis and probe triage — March rhythms
body:
Purpose:
Quick synthesis of recent customer murmurs (support threads + interview sprints) and a prioritized set of light probes we can run with eng/product in the next two weeks. This is intentionally rough — focus is on testable probes and fast feedback, not polished spec.

Topline signal (one sentence):
Customers want clearer, low-effort levers to trade cost vs latency and simple observability for cache/hit-rates and fallback events; several strategic accounts also want safer private deploy templates for compliance reviews.

Raw customer fragments we heard (verbatim-shorts):
- "We lost 40% throughput after last model swap, not sure if batching or quantization."
- "Why does dedup caching never show up in our dashboard?"
- "Need a way to pin fallback models per route — our app needs deterministic behavior when primary is busy."
- "Embeddings drifted on new fine-tune; similarity scores are noisy now."
- "Provide a simple toggle for 'prefer low-cost' in the API — devs will try it first before changing models."

Themes and impact buckets:
- Observability blindspots (dashboard gaps, cache visibility, fallback logging) — high frequency, medium severity
- Risky performance regressions (post-rollout latency/throughput changes) — medium frequency, high severity for enterprise
- Cost-control ergonomics (coarse toggles, unclear per-token costs when using caching/batching) — high frequency, medium severity for PLG
- Private/compliance templates (VPC onboarding docs + example KMS config) — low frequency, high impact for sales motion
- Embeddings/regression detection (no simple alert for semantic drift) — medium frequency, rising impact

Candidate quick probes (ranked by speed-to-learn):
1) Dashboard: "Cache-visibility" microtile (2 days) — add a single chart showing prefix/KV cache hit rate per model-route. Hypothesis: making this visible reduces support tickets about perceived regressions. Metric: tickets mentioning "cache" drops by 30% in next sprint.
2) API toggle prototype: "cost-prefer" query param (3 days + canary) — backend routes to cheaper compatible model variant on low-cost preference, returns field in response explaining tradeoff. Hypothesis: 10% of devs will opt-in and report acceptable quality. Metric: opt-in rate and quality regressions flagged < 5%.
3) Fallback pinning UI stub (4 days design + 1 week eng) — allow route-level pinned fallback model. Hypothesis: reduces customer workarounds and support escalations. Metric: incidence of emergency rollbacks after incidents falls.
4) Private onboarding checklist draft (1 week doc + sample terraform) — canonical KMS/network checklist. Hypothesis: shortens sales POC cycles for compliance customers by 25%. Metric: average POC time for accounts in compliance category.
5) Embedding drift probe: small eval harness (5 days) — run weekly similarity baseline and surface delta alerts when embedding similarity to seed set drops > 8%. Hypothesis: early detection prevents production accuracy losses. Metric: detection->fix time and number of cases caught.

Low-effort experimental guardrails we should include when running probes:
- Always include a lightweight opt-out flag for any behavioral change (e.g., cost-prefer).
- Annotate probe responses with an explicit "probe: true" tag in logs so we can filter signal.
- Route a small % of traffic or run in synthetic traffic before opting into customer accounts.

Open questions to resolve before dev work:
- Ownership: who owns the cache-visibility tile? Product-Console or Observability team? (suggest: console-and-rollouts + observability pairing)
- Permissions for fallback pinning: will enterprise tenants be allowed to pin any model variant or only within a whitelisted set?
- Embedding baseline cadence: weekly vs daily? (start weekly, iterate)

Proposed next steps (this week):
- Friday sync (CS + Product + Observability): triage and pick 1 surface to ship as a microtile (Naomi + Priya to run)
- Diego to sketch API param and sample response payload for cost-prefer (due Tue)
